q: When using this card's effect to digivolve a security card and I have a Tamer with [T.K. Takaishi] in its name, do I place 1 card in my security stack for
before or after I shuffle my security stack?

a: No, you can't. Since you have 3 cards in your security stack [BT8-024 Angemon]'s effect will trigger, but effects that add or remove cards from the security stack aren't allowed while looking at a security stack, so the effect won't activate.
